title: 英伟达：竟无明确二号人物，黄仁勋之后谁来接棒？

segments.en: Historically, a lot of CEOs have been called irreplaceable rights, Steve Jobs, for sure Jeff Bezos, another one. And in both those cases, those companies went on to do quite well without them.
segments.zh: 历史上，许多CEO被称为不可替代，比如史蒂夫·乔布斯，还有杰夫·贝索斯。但这两家公司在他们离开后都发展得相当不错。

segments.en: But I think what's different here is that they vary intentionally and methodically built companies that would carry on their ethos. And I'm just not sure that we're seeing the same thing at

segments.zh: 嗯，我认为在英伟达，没有二号人物，没有明确的接班人，也没有董事长。
